example.title: Grinnell Herald building (former bank), Main Street

brief: One-storey Neoclassical 'temple front' bank building in red brick with limestone trim: four brick pilasters with Ionic-scroll stone capitals carry a full stone entablature with an incised name frieze and a plain brick parapet. Between them, two huge window openings are now filled with glass block (small inset vents), and a centre entry has a stone eared surround with a glass door and a hanging sign. Basement windows under a stone sill band; corner lot.
